job.question: In the Los Angeles City Employees' Retirement System (LACERS) actuarial RFP, how many years of experience must the lead actuary have?
job.expected_facts: At least 15 years of experience with major public employee retirement systems, including at least 3 years with California public pension fund clients similar to LACERS.
job.acceptance: Accept 15 total and three California years. Do not require credential details unrelated to the years asked.

reviews.reason: This is an SFERS investment-consulting RFP, not the LACERS actuarial RFP. Its experience requirement concerns an investment professional, not a lead actuary, and it does not support the specified total and California-client experience requirements.
quotes: Request for Proposals for General Investment Consulting Services for the City and County of San Francisco Employees’ Retirement System
At least one key professional member of the Firm proposed for the SFERS account must have a minimum of ten (10) years of experience working with institutional clients.
